verdict.rationale: OpenClaw explicitly documents running multiple isolated agents in one Gateway process, each with its own workspace, state directory, and session history (openclaw-docs-25/76/93), and lets you pick per-provider/model settings (openclaw-docs-26); a community user corroborates running 9 agents with distinct personas from one machine (openclaw-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-agent distinct system prompts and explicit channel-to-agent routing rules/config beyond the general multi-agent concept doc.
